qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/run_golden.sh and results/{editor,runtime,persist-before,persist-after,polish,restart}.json, restart.log, build.log, golden-390.png, golden-1440-history.png (read only, not rerun)
evidence:
Walked instruction.md and the six /instructions notes line by line against solution/app. No asked-for screen, control or flow lacks an implementation.

WORKSPACE (overview.md, ui.md last paragraph): src/app.tsx:150-170 renders editor, preview and console panes together; title and filename fields and Save at :152; Run and Stop at :148; New at :157; saved library at :158; revision history with read-only title/filename/source and Restore at :159-162; draft-state marker at :144/:151 (dirty = code/title/filename vs baseline, :43); words after Run/Save via status (:72, runtime.ts:404 'Complete'); keyboard exit hint in footer :172 and custom-editor.js:1174. Phone layout: index.css '@media (max-width:520px)' block; golden-390.png shows editor, tools, library, preview and console stacked with no sideways overflow.

EDITOR (ui.md): own DOM surface, a div role=textbox with rendered .line/.gutter/.text rows (custom-editor.js:23, :1104-1142), no textarea/contenteditable and no editor library in package.json (acorn, acorn-walk, @lezer/html, prettier, react only). Line numbers :1127; 'Ln x, Col y' one-based :1109. Typing/Enter/Backspace/Delete/arrows/Home/End :323-355; Ctrl/Cmd+Home/End :281-285; Shift+arrows :804-806; remembered column :795-800; grapheme-aware movement and deletion via Intl.Segmenter :884-922; caret kept in view revealCaret :1145-1160. Mouse caret, double click word, triple click line, drag :358-447; copy/cut/paste events :248-267; paste as one Undo step (pushUndo for multi-character insert :585); long line stays unwrapped and scrollable (.custom-code-editor overflow:auto; white-space:pre, .line min-width:max-content). Tab/Shift+Tab block indent as one undo, excluding a next line touched only at column 0 :843-866. Alt and Ctrl/Cmd click carets :364-379; multi-caret typing by document offsets :592-610; multi-caret Backspace/Delete :680-724; untimed typing burst grouping :574-586, :624; Undo/Redo keys :298-308 and buttons :12, disabled when empty :1165-1166; history reset on New/open (setValue :72-80, app.tsx:59); caret restored by snapshot :190-215. Find/Next/Previous/Replace/Replace all, literal indexOf matching, wrap, current match selected :978-1102; Replace all via split/join as one undo :1092. Colouring for JS keyword/function/string/number/comment and HTML tag/attribute/quoted value/comment :105-188 with seven distinct tok-* colours in index.css. Format document through prettier standalone with babel and html parsers, two-space, no-op adds no undo step (:92), error leaves draft (:100-103), focus returned (:98, :65, app.tsx:68/:76).

RUNNING (behaviour.md, security.md): fresh sandboxed iframe per run (runtime.ts:389, sandbox='allow-scripts'); .html replaces the document (:320-321); syntax error reported with line and draft untouched (:387-388); console forwarded in order (:158, :400) and never cleared by a failing run; thrown error and unhandled rejection with one-based line, including HTML line offset (:213-229, :322, :357); last-good picture with control values and canvas pixels (:8-24, :159-203, :377-379, :404-405); five-second budget by loop/function guards plus watchdog (:139-141, :376); new budget on trusted interaction after settle (:270-282, :402); Stop and superseding Run discard the old token so late messages are ignored (:380-386, :397). Network closed by CSP connect-src 'none' and an opaque-origin sandbox (:7); eval/Function/WebAssembly/workers refused through CSP with a clear message (:220-228), dynamic import refused at parse (:50-52); no text scan, so the same words in strings or comments are harmless.

SAVING (behaviour.md, integration.md): server.js uses better-sqlite3 at DB_PATH or /app/app.db (:8, :143-169), listens on 0.0.0.0:PORT||3000 (:142), /api/health (:12), static files resolved from __dirname (:7, :130). Create/update with revision check and 409 on stale save (:52-59, :67-90); client keeps the dirty draft and shows a conflict notice (app.tsx:73-75, :153). History and restore as a new revision keeping intervening snapshots (:91-119); stale restore refused (:107); repeated restore request idempotent by operationId (:102-106) with a 'Retry same restore' control (app.tsx:162). Library polled every 2 s without touching the draft (app.tsx:136-141); newer-revision notice that keeps the draft (:142-143, :154). Requests are plain fetch calls (:11-16). No sign-in.

BUNDLE MATCHES SOURCE: public/assets/index.css is byte-identical to src/style.css, public/runner.html to static/runner.html, and probe strings from all three source files ('Already formatted.', 'script-src-attr', 'Load latest revision', 'Retry same restore', 'wasm-eval', 'operationId', 'Nothing to save') each occur in public/assets/index.js. `diff -rq` of the frozen task against projects/colderwater-playground-devtools reports no difference, so the scripted golden run was on these bytes.

MEASURED: all 22 hashes in raw-evidence-index.json reproduce (16 scripted-run artifacts on raw bytes, 6 hosted-run JSON files on LF-normalised bytes). Scripted results: editor.json 21/21 true, runtime.json 15/15 true, persist-before.json 8 entries true, persist-after.json cw_save_reload_restart true after a real restart (restart.log pid 37 -> 66), polish.json 7/7 true, pageErrors empty in every suite. This is scripted Playwright evidence in the agent image, not a configured judge run; no judge run exists for these bytes and none is claimed. The hosted Oracle 0.9833 belongs to an earlier candidate and is not used as evidence here.

NOTES (not defects for this row):
1. Typed (not pasted) characters are accepted only when event.key.length === 1 (custom-editor.js:352), and there is no hidden input for IME or OS emoji-picker entry, so an emoji or composed character entered from the keyboard is dropped. The brief requires such characters to 'move and delete as complete visible characters', which is implemented; entry by paste works.
2. setValue and paste normalise CRLF to LF (custom-editor.js:74, :250), so a snippet pasted with CRLF is saved with LF. 'Exact source' holds for everything the editor itself can produce.
3. A complete HTML file containing any external script, module script or non-JavaScript script type (for example a JSON data block) is refused as a whole run with 'Use local inline classic JavaScript; external and module scripts are unsupported.' (runtime.ts:328). Defensible under the no-network boundary, but stricter than the brief needs for a data block.
4. The preview CSP has no navigation restriction, so user code can navigate its own sandboxed frame to an app route (for example location = '/api/snippets'); the response is not readable by the snippet and the brief's stated test is that fetch requests fail, which they do. Belongs to the security rows if anyone wants to pursue it.
5. At 1440x900 the revision history sits at the bottom of the scrolling library block (.library max-height:36%) and is partly below the fold in golden-1440-history.png. It is reachable by scrolling; this is a craft point, not a missing deliverable.

Counterexample search: looked for a brief sentence with no code path (none found) and for a feature present only in src but absent from the shipped bundle (none found).
